_note: English twin of content/delivery.json: only the text the player reads (door captions, shop and item names, tags, typo names, who ordered the default, each meal's outside / bag / receipt / anomaly, the address). Same shops, items and days in the same order; a text that is null in the Chinese is null here; placeholders ({login}, {nick}, {bossCalls}) are kept as they are. A receipt that opens with an item name in the Chinese opens with that item's English name here (the opening is swapped for what the player ordered). Typo names have one wrong letter, written by hand. Checked by src/state/delivery/twin.ts at load and by npm run validate.

steps: Walk to the door (the camera turns to the door wall)
The bag is on the desk corner

items.name: Spicy hot pot · pick your own

lunch.by: Lao Zhou ordered it for you, sent to your place

lunch.outside: The corridor light is white. One person's footsteps go down the stairs.
lunch.bag: Hot. The top is tied in a hard knot.

lunch.outside: Footsteps. Someone stands outside the door for two seconds before putting it down.

dinner.outside: No footsteps. The bag is already there.

lunch.outside: The corridor floor is still wet. A line of footprints comes to your door and turns back.
lunch.bag: Hot. The knot at the top is the one you always tie. It is tied your way.
lunch.anomaly: The knot is tied your way.

lunch.outside: The doorbell rings, and it sounds a little off, the last note dragging on. You wonder if the bell is about to give out.
lunch.receipt: Braised chicken rice · no coriander · Note: wait
lunch.anomaly: There is one word in the note field: wait. You never wrote a note.

dinner.bag: Heavy. There is a box of rice inside that you didn't order.
dinner.anomaly: One box of rice too many.

lunch.receipt: Braised chicken rice · no coriander · Note: no
lunch.anomaly: Today the note says "no". You did not write that one either.

dinner.outside: The footsteps stop at the door and don't leave. You wait a while and look again. The corridor is empty.
dinner.bag: Cold. As if it has been sitting there a long time.
dinner.anomaly: The order time is two minutes before you ordered.

lunch.outside: The rider's photo is a very blurred face. You didn't notice last time.
lunch.anomaly: The rider in the app is the same person as yesterday. And the day before.

dinner.anomaly: There is a typo on the receipt.

lunch.outside: The corridor light is a little pink.
lunch.bag: Hot. There is an extra piece of paper in the bag: "take your time", handwritten by the shop. The writing looks a lot like yours.

dinner.outside: No footsteps, no lift. The bag is there.
dinner.anomaly: The recipient is the name your boss calls you.

lunch.outside: Someone is talking outside the door, very low, too low to make out. It sounds like two people. When you open the door the corridor is empty.
lunch.receipt: Braised chicken rice · no coriander · Note: 0487
lunch.anomaly: The note is a string of digits.

lunch.outside: The rider's photo in the app has changed. Now it is plain grey, with no face.
lunch.receipt: Braised chicken rice · no coriander · Note: you in? No coriander
lunch.anomaly: The note is what Lao Zhou said in the group today.

dinner.bag: Warm. The bag is moving a little, as if there were a heartbeat inside. You open it. It is the soup sloshing.

lunch.outside: The corridor light is white. One person's footsteps go down the stairs.
lunch.bag: Hot. The top is tied in a hard knot.
lunch.receipt: Braised chicken rice · mild · Note: no coriander (Lao Zhou)
lunch.anomaly: Exactly the same as the first day. Even the crease in the receipt is the same.

lunch.outside: The corridor light is pink, and steady.
lunch.receipt: Braised chicken rice · no coriander · Good to see you.
lunch.anomaly: The receipt says good to see you.

dinner.outside: The rider says one sentence outside the door, in Kuro's tone. What it says is "Your delivery is here."
dinner.receipt: Wontons · One step at a time.
dinner.anomaly: The receipt says what the boss said today.

lunch.outside: It is very quiet outside the door.
lunch.bag: Hot. There is an extra receipt in the bag, from 1997. The paper has gone yellow. You know the shop's name. It closed long ago.

lunch.outside: The corridor walls are breathing. You don't look for long.
lunch.receipt: Braised chicken rice · no coriander · Note: {nick}, have you eaten
lunch.anomaly: The note is what they say at home, with the name they call you at home.

dinner.outside: Nobody. The bag has been pushed in under the door, flat.
dinner.bag: Flat. Inside is paper: an upgrade notice.
dinner.anomaly: No food. It is an upgrade notice.

lunch.outside: The footsteps are very light, as if afraid to disturb you.
lunch.bag: Hot. There is a seaweed egg drop soup you didn't order.
lunch.receipt: Braised chicken rice · no coriander · Soup (free) · Note: you've worked hard, take care
lunch.anomaly: A gentle day. Even the receipt is gentle.

dinner.outside: Two bags outside the door. One is yours. The other says "for upstairs". Nobody lives upstairs.
dinner.receipt: Wontons · Note: take your time, no rush

lunch.outside: The corridor light goes on and off, in time with the chick's pixels.
lunch.receipt: Braised chicken rice · no coriander · Note: did you dream of the drawer
lunch.anomaly: The note is about the dream.

dinner.outside: Footsteps come all the way to the door, don't stop, keep going, and walk into the wall.
dinner.bag: Warm. Inside is a rice ball shaped like a phoenix. The shop doesn't sell this.

lunch.outside: In the app: shop closed. All four shops are closed, the convenience store too.
lunch.anomaly: The takeout isn't coming. You go hungry for the first time.

dinner.outside: Footsteps outside, stopping at the door. You don't open it.
dinner.anomaly: The door stays shut. It is locked. You locked it.

lunch.outside: No footsteps. One bag at the door.
lunch.bag: Cold, and very light. Inside are the things you handed over these days and never got back. Every one is there, laid out in order of the days.
Hot. One braised chicken rice, no coriander. Like the first day.
lunch.receipt: Braised chicken rice · no coriander · Note: you worked hard today too

dinner.outside: No sound outside the door. There is a shipping form on the desk, waiting for you to fill it in.
